title: Equations of motion (গতির সমীকরণ)
placement: Book pages 45–46, topic 2.7: গতির সমীকরণ (Equations of Motion). Next to the section text on uniform acceleration (v = u + at), in place of a printed picture.
description: The equations of motion (গতির সমীকরণ, pages 45–46, 2.7) as the owner's reference "Uniform Acceleration in One Dimension": a blue sedan (wheels that turn with the motion, windows, lights) drives along a raised road under a light-blue sky; the road's front edge is the number line from −7 m to 10 m with a numbered tick every metre, and a dot marks the car's position x. Four sliders set the আদি অবস্থান x₀ (red, −5…5 m), the আদি বেগ u (blue, −5…5 m/s; the book's symbol for the reference's v₀), the ত্বরণ a (green, −3…3 ms⁻²) and the সময় t (grey, 0…6 s), all in steps of 0.1; চালাও runs the time in real seconds (থামাও pauses), quiet buttons go back to the start or one 0.1 s step back or forward. Under the axis the three parts of x = x₀ + ut + ½at² are drawn tip to tail as outlined arrows (x₀ red from 0, ut blue, ½at² green ending at the car's x), so x is their sum. The panel shows the formula, two small live graphs (x against t, a parabola; v against t, a straight line) growing as t runs with the moment marked, the live equations with the numbers filled in, x = (½a)t² + (u)t + (x₀) and v = (a)t + (u), and one sentence (the sum, the moment the car turns back, or that it has reached an end of the axis and stopped). Test: 5 tap questions (x after t with x₀ read off the axis, v = u + at, a read from the x equation, when v = 0 from the v equation, the part ½at² read off the picture), wrong choices from real mistakes, each worked answer naming the mistake and running the car to that moment. Phone-first, Bangla. GLB: the road with its number line and the three arrows, and the car, in metres.
